proof_summary: Define an auxiliary sequence by \(u_0=1, u_1=-2\) and \(u_{n+2}=-4u_{n+1}-64u_n\); eliminating the mixed products shows that \(u_{n+1}^2\) and the odd-indexed terms satisfy the same third-order recurrence. Agreement of the first three values then gives \(a_{2n+1}=u_{n+1}^2\) for all \(n\).
